name: engineering-figure-codex
description: Codex Desktop plugin for engineering and research figures.

interface.shortDescription: Create engineering figures, paper diagrams, and exact plots in Codex.
interface.longDescription: Engineering Figure Codex provides Codex Desktop workflows for system architecture diagrams, paper-style conceptual figures, and exact local publication plots. It does not require image API keys or route image requests through third-party providers.
defaultPrompt: Use Engineering Figure Codex to draw a Chinese RAG architecture figure with OCR, chunking, embedding, vector search, rerank, and answer synthesis.
Use Engineering Figure Codex to design an English paper-style method figure for my system.
Use Engineering Figure Codex to render an exact benchmark plot from this data.
